name: @resonantos/addon-sdk
description: Public Resonant Extension Framework (REF) add-on SDK — manifest contract, capability model, validator, registry, and surface-routing helpers. See ADR-038 §12.1 C12 (Public SDK External Boundary) and ADR-040.
intent: Fork-only soft cutover per ADR-038 §12.1 C12. The package is not yet published; this manifest records the intended public boundary. When the SDK is extracted to a real workspace (Phase 1 of the implementation roadmap), the source files in src/ become the published surface and the existing src/sdk/addons/ shims in this repo are removed.
sourceLocation: src/sdk/addons/ (shims — keep for backward compat); canonical: packages/addon-sdk/src/
